UpdateRoleRequest.description: Request to change a user's role

AppUserDto.description: Application user, linked to a Firebase account, with an assigned role

referenceDurationDays.description: Reference duration (in days) used to compute the time factor of contribution units

currentPhase.description: Current lifecycle phase, used to look up the risk factor

ownerUid.description: Firebase UID of the project owner

budget.description: Initial budget allocated to the project

existingStructures.description: Whether existing structures are present on the land

projectId.description: Project this operation belongs to (optional, for backward compatibility with the global ledger)

shares.description: List of shares per investor (total must equal 100%)

SetFinancialParameterRequest.description: Request to set (create or override) a financial coefficient

paramKey.description: Parameter key, e.g. RISK_FACTOR:STABLE or IMPACT_FACTOR

projectId.description: Project to override; omit for a global default

FinancialParameterDto.description: A configurable financial coefficient (risk factor, impact factor...)

projectId.description: Project this override applies to; null means a global default

WithdrawalDto.description: A capital withdrawal request against a contribution

contributionId.description: Contribution this withdrawal is taken from

blockReason.description: Reason the withdrawal is blocked, if applicable

requestedBy.description: AppUser id who requested this withdrawal

validatedBy.description: AppUser id who validated or rejected this withdrawal

RepaymentDto.description: A planned or paid repayment of principal + interest for a LOAN or TEMPORARY_INVESTMENT contribution

CreateProjectRequest.description: Request payload to create a new project

livestockType.description: Livestock type — required when projectType is LIVESTOCK

ProposeDistributionRequest.description: Request to propose a new profit distribution for a project and period

taxes.description: Taxes to deduct from the period's result

reserve.description: Reserve to keep aside before distributing

reinvestment.description: Amount to reinvest into the project before distributing

ProfitDistributionDto.description: A profit distribution proposed (and possibly validated) for a project and period

operatingCosts.description: Operating costs recorded for this period

distributableProfit.description: Distributable profit (floored at 0 in case of a loss)

proposedBy.description: AppUser id who proposed this distribution

validatedBy.description: AppUser id who validated or rejected this distribution

ProfitDistributionLineDto.description: One investor's share of a profit distribution

contributionId.description: Contribution this line is based on

unitsOfContribution.description: Units of Contribution (UC) at the time of this distribution

CreateContributionRequest.description: Request to record a new investor contribution to a project

type.description: Contribution type; defaults to EQUITY if omitted

assetId.description: Asset being contributed to capital; required for IN_KIND, ignored otherwise

ContributionDto.description: An investor's contribution to a project, with its entry valuation

valuationBeforeEntry.description: Project value immediately before this contribution

sharePercentageAtEntry.description: Ownership percentage this contribution bought at entry (0-100); 0 for non-equity types (LOAN, TEMPORARY_INVESTMENT, LABOR)

assetId.description: Asset contributed to capital, only set for IN_KIND contributions

CreateAssetRequest.description: Request to register a new asset for a project

initialValue.description: Documented initial value, must be positive

AssetDto.description: A physical good (land, farm, machine...) brought to or used by a project

ownershipStatus.description: Whether the asset is owned by its contributor (leasable) or transferred to the project's capital

disposition.description: Settlement at project closure, only meaningful for TRANSFERRED_TO_PROJECT assets

LeaseDto.description: Terms under which a project pays rent for an asset it does not own

RequestWithdrawalRequest.description: Request to withdraw capital from a contribution

amount.description: Amount to withdraw, must be positive and not exceed the remaining position

ScheduleRepaymentRequest.description: Request to schedule a repayment for a LOAN or TEMPORARY_INVESTMENT contribution

principalAmount.description: Principal to repay, must be positive

DisposeAssetRequest.description: Request to settle a capital asset once its project is closed (doc Q11)

disposition.description: SOLD (to a third party) or RETAINED_BY_INVESTOR (an investor buys it)

amount.description: Sale/settlement proceeds credited to the project as income

buyerInvestorId.description: Buyer investor id, required when disposition is RETAINED_BY_INVESTOR

CreateLeaseRequest.description: Request to lease an asset to a project

AssetUsageSimulationDto.description: Hypothetical monthly usage cost of one asset, as if it were rented

ProjectUsageSimulationDto.description: "Everyone pays rent" simulation (doc §9.4): the hypothetical cost of using every asset as if it were rented, compared to the rent actually being paid today

monthlyRatePercent.description: Monthly rate applied to each asset's value, as a percentage

totalHypotheticalMonthlyCost.description: Sum of every asset's hypothetical monthly cost

actualCurrentMonthlyRent.description: Sum of currently active leases' monthly rent (what is actually paid today)

RoiDto.description: Return on investment for an investor's equity-like position in a project (doc §13)

totalReceived.description: Total received so far (profit distributions + validated withdrawals)

annualizedRoiPercent.description: Annualized ROI: (1 + ROI)^(365/daysInvested) - 1, as a percentage

daysInvested.description: Days since the earliest equity-like contribution

InvestorShareDto.description: An investor's current ownership share of a project, based on Units of Contribution

currentProjectValue.description: Current estimated project value (equity book value, net of withdrawals)

totalCapitalInvested.description: Total EQUITY/IN_KIND capital ever contributed (gross, before withdrawals)

remainingTemporaryCapital.description: Outstanding LOAN/TEMPORARY_INVESTMENT principal still to be repaid

assetsValueOwnedByContributors.description: Documented value of assets still owned by their contributors (leasable, not capital)

currentMonthlyRent.description: Sum of all currently active leases' monthly rent

totalReserveAccumulated.description: Cumulative reserve set aside across all validated distributions

totalDistributedToDate.description: Total amount already paid out across all validated distributions

currentShares.description: Current ownership breakdown across equity-like investors

bearerAuth.description: Paste the Firebase ID token obtained from the client SDK
